say: Бизнесы, которые не выглядят прибыльными, но приносят кучу денег. Эва-коврики для машин.
prompt: Continuous detailed hand-drawn cel animation, stable full-length camera. Preserve the exact same amber-eyed black panther with the same indigo bob, burgundy tie, black bowler and gold trim. She speaks from the start, jaw opens and closes clearly in sync with the supplied Russian speech, she blinks, raises the black car mat slightly and shows its red edge to the viewer. The mat tilts visibly in her paws, a small reflection glides over the shiny car, her black tail sways subtly. Keep the white working garage, colorful mat stacks, positions and illustrated style, no cuts, no overlays, no text.

say: В гараже вырезаешь коврик по лекалу. А в машине ячейки удерживают воду с обуви.
prompt: Continuous detailed hand-drawn cel animation, same amber-eyed black panther with indigo bob and bowler, red vest and gloves at the workbench. She speaks clearly from the first syllable; show her jaw articulating in sync with the Russian audio. She guides the small utility cutter along the paper outline, the rubber sheet flexes visibly, then lifts the honeycomb edge toward camera while continuing to speak. One hanging roll sways softly in the background. Maintain the warm lit garage, existing tools, hand anatomy and illustrated style. Static camera, no cut, no text.
